newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Equitable Bank eyes troubled Monte bank.
newsitem.headline: Equitable Bank eyes troubled Monte bank.

text.p: Equitable Banking Corp is negotiating with owners of Monte de Piedad Savings and Mortgage Bank for a possible buy-in of the financially troubled thrift bank, a Central Bank official said on Friday.
Equitable is the latest prospective buyer to meet with Monte owners and Central Bank officials who are overseeing the rehabilitation of Monte bank after it suffered heavy withdrawals early this week.

The bank, which is now temporarily closed, is negotiating with interested investors who could bring in fresh capital to write off 1.8 billion pesos worth of uncollectible loans given to tricycle drivers and operators.

On Thursday, four groups expressed interest in acquiring the thrift bank. These are Lippo Bank of Indonesia, Keppel Bank of Singapore, Banco de Oro, a local commercial bank owned by shopping mall magnate Henry Sy, and another group of businessmen.
